session.name: MPI-387 raised - clean Windows 11 install broken end-to-end; splash + sam2 fixes shipped

goal.original: A second user reported the app not starting on Windows 11. Diagnose it, with the user reproducing a full install on a clean Windows 11 Home laptop (integrated graphics, no NVIDIA).
goal.summary: Six defects, all evidence-backed from a captured app.log plus live user testing. TWO ARE SHIPPED: the white-splash flash (335fe260) and the git+sam2 requirement (f371a162, with a test). FOUR REMAIN. Every remaining one has an exact file:line fix site - do not re-derive them. Full evidence is in the MPI-387 brief; read it before touching anything.

completed: SHIPPED 335fe260 - white splash: shown before Chromium first paint, backgroundColor does not cover that gap. show:false + ready-to-show, plus a .catch() on loadFile whose rejection escaped the try/catch and would now kill the process via the MPI-369 unhandledRejection handler.

SHIPPED f371a162 - Impact-Pack git+sam2 drop on all three platforms, proven unused by grep, byte-exact against the locked requirements.txt at 429d0159, pinned by a test that also asserts SAM 1 survives.
MAX_PATH measured exactly: 266 chars vs the 260 limit, over by six. Cause is a double-nested archive root worth 32 chars.
DISPROVED the extraction-race theory using the real log - sequencing is correct, all 14 extractions succeeded.
Empirically REJECTED .lnk as a launcher: it stores an absolute target path (verified by renaming the parent folder).
Researched signing: EV no longer grants instant reputation, OV is equivalent, SAC blocks signed binaries too.
Mapped the portable-relayout blast radius: 7 blockers incl. an entirely missing build step. Linux/macOS unaffected.
Proved the Retry loop is permanent, with the mechanism (see constraints).
Confirmed NONE of the six defects affect the remote/Pod engine - custom nodes are baked at image build time and _runCustomNodeInstall is not called for engine === remote.
pending: A (MAX_PATH): scripts/build-portable.mjs:1062 - the full archive is written with includeRoot:true, and rootName (line 1006) is CubricVision-<label>-<arch>-v<version>, 30 chars. Windows Extract All then nests that name twice. NEEDS A USER DECISION - see key_decisions.

A (preflight): add an install-root depth guard in routes/engine.js _runEngineDownload (after ~line 360); ENGINE_ROOT comes from getEngineRoot() in routes/platformEngine.js. Unlike the archive change this one travels in an update bundle, and it is the load-bearing fix because no archive name saves a user who extracts somewhere deep.

C (wrong message): routes/downloadManager.js:2202-2205 throws "One or more custom node extractions failed" for ALL loop failures. anyFailure is ONE boolean set at 2049, 2055, 2088, 2158, 2169 and 2186 with no extraction-vs-pip distinction. It surfaces at routes/engine.js:393 and the generic toast at :474. Split into anyExtractionFailure / anyPipFailure and carry the child process message, which already names the package and reason.

F1 (reconciler false positive): routes/comfy.js:718-720 _localModelsCheck uses pathExists for custom_nodes deps. The rife47 weight has targetPath custom_nodes/comfyui-frame-interpolation/ckpts/rife, and FileDownloader._ensureDownloader (downloadManager.js:663) ensureDir-s it, creating the parent node folder as a side effect. Fix: use the _nodeFolderHasFiles guard that _runCustomNodeInstall already has at downloadManager.js:86-93 - extract it to a shared util. NOTE: no work is actually dropped, the warn is cosmetically wrong only.

F2 (wrong GPU build): routes/platformEngine.js:283-293 defaults to the NVIDIA 7z when nothing is detected, and detectIntelArcGPU (:230-241) only matches Intel Arc / Data Center, never Iris/UHD/HD integrated. Every non-discrete-GPU laptop downloads the CUDA build. Product decision on whether a lighter build exists; at minimum log the intentional fallthrough.

F3 (low): ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation install.py swallows a cupy-wheel build failure (pkg_resources gone in setuptools 81+) and exits 0, so runCustomCommand (routes/shared.js:305-319) correctly resolves. cupy is optional for RIFE - torch fallback is adequate. Document or drop cupy; the exit-code check itself is correct.
D (relayout): own effort, 7 blockers, see the brief.
E (release notes): existing Windows 11 SAC users can only be reached by a fresh full download.

key_decisions: FIX A NEEDS A USER CALL. Option 1: build-portable.mjs:1062 includeRoot:false - saves all 32 chars (266 -> 234), but the zip then has no top-level folder, so a user who picks "Extract Here" in 7-Zip sprays thousands of files into Downloads. Windows Extract All (the default) still creates exactly one folder. Option 2: keep includeRoot:true and shorten rootName (line 1006) - no spray risk, but CubricVision-v<version> only saves 12 chars (266 -> 254) and the reproducing user has a 5-character username; a longer name breaks it again. The update bundle already uses a deliberately short version-first root (updateRootName, line 1021) for the MPI-62 Safari-truncation reason, so precedent exists for option 2. RECOMMENDATION: option 1 plus the preflight depth check, because option 2 alone leaves almost no margin.
The relayout (D) is decoupled from the install fixes. A and C ship without touching the layout.
Linux and macOS keep the current layout - .sh and .command are not SAC-blocked. Windows-only branch in the build script.
Signing is eventually necessary but is NOT a fix for SAC and is not urgent. Do not buy a cert expecting it to unblock users.
A 1.2.1 patch can carry B and C via an update bundle. A does NOT reach existing installs - it changes how the zip is packaged, not what is already on disk. 1.2.1 does nothing for SAC-blocked users.

Release base is PARKED pending a parallel session assessing master (116 commits / 167 non-doc files ahead of v1.2.0, so it is not a patch). No branch has been created - do not create one without the user naming the base.
constraints: THE RACE THEORY IS DEAD. Node extraction does not race engine extraction; the log proves correct sequencing and all 14 extractions succeeded. Do not re-open it.
.lnk IS REJECTED. It stores an absolute path, verified empirically. Do not re-propose it as a launcher.

THE RETRY LOOP IS PERMANENT, and here is why: writeNodeCommitMarker (downloadManager.js:2195) is the SOLE persistent record of a good install, and the `continue` at 2169/2186 skips it on any pip failure. Next boot, checkUniversalWorkflowDepsStatus (shared.js:598) finds the folder but no .mpi_node_commit, marks the dep drifted, and re-installs. Pip fails the same way. Retry via /engine/download also re-downloads the WHOLE multi-GB engine each time. Fixing A and B ends the loop.
The update ARCHIVE NAME is frozen (MPI-369) - shipped updaters glob it by name. Only the extracted root folder name is free.
_filterRequirements matches with `name === d` after trim+lowercase. Any new drop string must be byte-exact against the locked requirements.txt or it is a silent no-op.
requirementsDrop trap: _createDepJob is a WHITELIST (downloadManager.js:456). Unlisted dep fields vanish silently.
No symptom patches: no retry loop, no ensure-dir band-aid that just moves the failure to the pip step, no try/catch at the error site.
None of these six affect the remote/Pod engine. Do not sweep it.
The CHANGELOG hold on masking still stands: one entry when MPI-368 shapes land, not per-card.
Docs-repo push block still applies. Push is user-authorized only.
9 pre-existing test failures are UNCARDED and unrelated; check the failure LIST, not the count. Runner is `node --test tests/*.test.cjs`.
